normalized.description: The device must be robust enough to withstand normal wear and tear in an industrial environment. The device must be lightweight, portable and must include a holder to carry the device on your person, easily accessible and CE compliant. A sample device must be provided to examine these features with tender. The device must be water resistant (e.g. IP67). The device must have a minimum 50 hour plus duration of battery life in normal operational use per single charge. Easily activated SOS button to request assistance 2-way speaker communication following alarm activation GPS positioning with alert delivery over 2/3/4G The solution must be end to end and must operate independently of the Council’s own ICT infrastructure Fall/Man Down alarm functionality - activation capability (can be turned on/off) should be included. Functionality should provide for an event including falls or sudden impact. Capability for the response Centre to let the user know they are listening (discretely and otherwise). Access to a 24-hour response Centre licensed by the Private Security Authority (PSA) for dealing with alarms. Please supply one (1) proposed device with tender response document. Tenderers must provide training for Wexford County Council staff in Council Offices on award of contract. Please note tender price for devices should include the cost of training. The Tenderer will be required to provide monthly information to the Health and Safety Section at Wexford County Council Offices to discuss: Contract performance; Use of device; Training needs; Incident reviews; Invoicing details; Service satisfaction. Please note a monthly email is required outlining incidents in previous month. The Tenderer will be required to outline the lone working system administration requirements. Preference given to tenders minimizing end user administration for Wexford County Council.

Title: Netherlands – Mowers – Levering van maaikorven inclusief onderdelen
Procedure title: Levering van maaikorven inclusief onderdelen
Description: Waterschap Rijn en IJssel maakt voor het onderhoud van watergangen, dijken en overige terreinen gebruik van maaikorven van de merken Hobelman en Herder. Om de continuïteit, veiligheid en doelmatigheid van deze werkzaamheden te waarborgen, bestaat ook de komende jaren behoefte aan de levering van maaikorven en onderdelen. Het waterschap kiest ervoor de huidige merken binnen het machinepark te blijven ondersteunen vanwege de aanwezige kennis, de bestaande onderhoudsorganisatie en de bewezen inzetbaarheid van deze machines. Daarnaast wenst het waterschap binnen deze aanbesteding ook het merk Rumex mee te nemen, zodat gedurende de contractperiode de mogelijkheid bestaat om maaikorven en onderdelen van dit merk af te nemen. Hiermee behoudt het waterschap flexibiliteit bij toekomstige vervangings- en uitbreidingsinvesteringen. Zie leidraad.
Lot description: Dit betreft het perceel Herder. Perceel 1 Herder: € 1.000.000 excl. BTW. Dit betreft het perceel Hobelman. Perceel 2 Hobelman: € 350.000 excl. BTW. Dit betreft het perceel Rumex. Perceel 3 Rumex: € 350.000 excl. BTW.
